data.narrative:
Picogrid is a Series A-stage defense and security company founded by Zane Mountcastle, Martin Slosarik, and Dan Chirita. The company has raised $45M+ to date. The valuation analysis references a peer universe of 10 comparable companies—2 public (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms including Stark Defence, Singularity, NODA AI, Anduril Industries, and Helsing.

Two triangulation methods apply. The stage-progression method uses $45M in total capital raised as a proxy for current value, then applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical for Series A advancement, implying a $90M valuation. The peer-median method draws on three same-sector, same-stage comparables: Stark Defence ($4.0B), Singularity ($400M), and NODA AI ($125M). The median of this peer set is $400M, establishing an upper-quartile reference point. The peer range spans $125M to $4.0B, reflecting material heterogeneity in the Defense & Security segment at this stage.

These methods produce a triangulated valuation range of $76M (low) to $460M (high), with a median of $245M. The substantial spread reflects structural uncertainty: the stage-progression method anchors conservatively to deployed capital, while peer-median is heavily influenced by outliers in a thin comp set. Key uncertainties include revenue trajectory, customer concentration in defense procurement, and the extent to which Picogrid's technology and go-to-market warrant positioning toward the higher-valuation peers versus the lower-end defensiveness of capital-deployed benchmarks.
